$comment: Single source of truth for imagery. `npm run manifest` regenerates prompts/image-manifest.md from this file. Drop a real file into public/images/<kind>/<filename> and the placeholder plate is replaced automatically at build time.

images.subject: A second-floor apartment window at dusk, one of many, the only one lit; the glass carries a faint reflection of the street trees behind the viewer.
images.concept: Two worlds occupying the same surface. You can attend to the room or to the reflection, never both at once.
images.purpose: Sets the essay's premise before a word of it is read.

images.subject: A field-guide plate of a single room, drawn twice: once complete in fine hairline ink, once as the four or five marks that survived being looked at.
images.concept: The paraphrase. What the editor kept.
images.purpose: Gives the pull quote something to argue with rather than decorate.

images.subject: An old dog lying at the edge of a rectangle of afternoon light on a wood floor, having moved with it; the previous position still visible as a dent in a rug.
images.concept: Sustained attention without effort. The animal is better at this than you are.
images.purpose: Carries the essay's central practical claim: noticing is a matter of speed, not will.

images.subject: An enormous flat bank of weather over a grey lake, with one very small figure standing on a breakwater far right of centre.
images.concept: Scale as an attention device. The eye has to travel to find the person.
images.purpose: The book's first long exhale. No text, no folio.
images.revision: Keep the horizon clear of the fold; the figure must sit fully on the recto.

images.subject: Wet sidewalk after rain, a scatter of starlings on a wire above it, arranged by accident into something that reads like handwriting.
images.concept: The world composing itself without intending to.
images.purpose: Opens Part I on an image of a pattern that was always there.

images.subject: Four strangers at a crosswalk, all looking at four different things, their shadows overlapping into a single shape.
images.concept: Four separate paraphrases of one street corner.
images.purpose: Interrupts the text at the foot of the verso, so the spread has weight where it would otherwise trail off.
